description: This file defines a React component 'UserInfoView' which displays detailed information about a user, including basic info, teams, models, and allows actions like editing, deleting, and resetting passwords. It includes hooks for fetching data, handling user updates, and managing UI state.

methods.name: handleResetPassword
methods.description: Generates a password reset link via API call and displays it in a modal.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Deletes the user via API call, shows notification, and triggers callback.

methods.name: handleUserUpdate
methods.description: Sends updated user data to API and updates local state upon success.

methods.name: copyToClipboard
methods.description: Copies specified text to clipboard and temporarily shows a success icon.
